summary: AI document-extraction pipeline (GPT-4o vision + Azure Document Intelligence) that releases cargo shipments, processing ~$800M USD across 10+ countries at 90%+ extraction accuracy.
Intent engine and conversational AI modules for customer feedback, plus a fine-tuned BERT pipeline (F1 0.91) for ticket sentiment and priority.
Research on "Temporal Belief Dynamics in BERT": graph-theoretic analysis of representation drift, accepted at ICCIS 2025.
